description: This source file defines a GUI wizard component for a Java application, specifically related to triggering and controlling hardware components in an automotive or engine ECU context. It includes UI components, user interaction logic, and commands for hardware control.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Main class implementing a multi-step GUI wizard for triggering and testing hardware commands in the application.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Interface representing a step in the wizard, providing UI content.

classes.name: WizardStepImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing WizardStep, with support for chaining to next steps.

classes.name: SendCommand
classes.description: Concrete WizardStep implementation that sends a command and proceeds upon confirmation.

classes.name: WaitForZeroRpm
classes.description: Wizard step that waits until the RPM sensor reads zero before proceeding.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Creates the main UI panel for the wizard with buttons and content areas.

methods.name: applyStep
methods.description: Transitions the wizard to a given step, updating UI content accordingly.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content UI component for the current step.

methods.name: scheduleRepaint
methods.description: Schedules a delayed UI update or check in the wizard.
